run_xarm6_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation of an XArm6 robot with physics stepping and gravity
create_xarm6_instance: create an XArm6Sim robot instance at a given position using xarm_sim and pybullet
configure_pybullet_physics: configure pybullet physics with a custom time step and gravity settings
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to pybullet in GUI mode and set the additional search path for assets
step_simulation_loop: step the XArm6 robot and pybullet simulation in a continuous loop with sleep
